entities.summary: Sainte-Anne de Varennes Basilica is a Roman Catholic minor basilica dedicated to Saint Anne located in Varennes, Quebec, Canada. The basilica is under the circumscription of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Saint-Jean-Longueuil. The basilica was decreed on June 18, 1993.
